_notes: Paseo worktree lifecycle. Setup builds tokens so the package outputs exist for local work.

Concurrency hazard (GUARDED): `pnpm yalc:publish` writes to the SHARED global ~/.yalc store and pushes into every linked consumer (web + mantle-LifegamesPortal, including their other worktrees). scripts/yalc-publish-guarded.sh refuses the publish from any linked worktree; a deliberate worktree publish requires YALC_PUBLISH_FROM_WORKTREE=1. Publish from the main checkout.
